items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: Pricing is individual: it depends on the type of site, design and technical complexity, the number of pages and modules (forms, catalogues, calculators, integrations) and whether you need ongoing support. We give an exact estimate after a short consultation and task analysis.

items.q: Do you handle promotion after launch?
items.a: Yes. We are a full-cycle agency: after launch we can run SEO, Google Ads, SMM and email marketing, and provide technical support for the site. To start, we offer a free SEO check and a Google/Facebook ads audit.

On average we deliver a finished product in about a month, but it can be longer or shorter depending on the project’s complexity. A landing page is faster; an online store or platform takes longer. We confirm exact timelines after a consultation.

items.q: Can you work with an existing website?
items.a: Yes. We can run a usability audit and SEO check, refresh the design, extend functionality, set up advertising and take the site on for technical support. We start by analysing the current state and propose what will have the biggest impact.

items.q: What makes Click IT different from other agencies?
items.a: We cover the whole cycle — from niche research and design to development, advertising and promotion — so you don’t have to coordinate several contractors. We care not only about code but also UI/UX, branding and marketing, work in a tailored way and stay with you after launch.

cta.lead: Let’s unlock your business’s full potential — together.
